instruction: Write an XDP program that inspects network traffic and must defend against SYN floods using BPF_MAP_TYPE_HASH map 'syn_subnet_map' dropping TCP SYN packets from subnets exceeding rate. Forward all other packets with XDP_PASS.
requirements: Define BPF_MAP_TYPE_HASH map 'syn_subnet_map' with key __u32 (/24 prefix) and value __u32
Verify Ethernet, IPv4, and TCP header bounds against data_end
If tcp->syn is asserted, extract /24 subnet (ip->saddr & 0x00FFFFFF) and lookup in map
Drop packet with XDP_DROP if SYN count exceeds 200
SEC("xdp") entry point and GPL license declaration
